mapper.select: SELECT partner_idx, partner_nm, partner_status, partner_tel, partner_email, gender, CAST(create_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS create_dt, CAST(update_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS update_dt, partner_birth, p_zip_cd, p_address, p_address_detail, p_region FROM partner_mst ORDER BY partner_idx DESC

SELECT szm.zone_idx, sm.store_idx, ((szm.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS setting_date_ymd, COALESCE(sm.store_nm, '') AS store_nm, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = '30' AND cm.code_cd = sm.store_type) AS franchise_label, CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = '40' AND cm.code_cd = CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, sm.region_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = '20' AND cm.code_cd = sm.region_cd) AS region_nm, pm.prop_nm, CASE WHEN sm.store_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL THEN '설정' WHEN sm.store_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.zone_idx IS NULL THEN '미설정' WHEN sm.store_idx IS NULL AND szm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL THEN '전략출점' ELSE '기타' END AS area_setting_label, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS sales_area_nm, (sm.store_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL) AS is_area_configured, (sm.store_idx IS NULL AND szm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL) AS is_strategic_opening, (sm.store_idx IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(sm.store_type, '') = 'FR') AS is_franchise, NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, pm.address, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address_detail, '')), '') )), '') AS map_address, sm.latitude AS latitude, sm.longitude AS longitude FROM sale_zone_mst szm FULL OUTER JOIN store_mst sm ON szm.zone_idx = sm.zone_idx LEFT OUTER JOIN property_mst pm ON sm.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx ORDER BY szm.zone_idx NULLS LAST, sm.store_idx NULLS LAST

SELECT CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS zone_idx, sm.store_idx, TO_CHAR( COALESCE(sm.cont_start_dt, (sm.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setting_date_ymd, sm.store_nm, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = '30' AND cm.code_cd = sm.store_type) AS franchise_label, CAST(sm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = '40' AND cm.code_cd = CAST(sm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, sm.region_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = '20' AND cm.code_cd = sm.region_cd) AS region_nm, pm.prop_nm, '미설정' AS area_setting_label, '' AS sales_area_nm, FALSE AS is_area_configured, FALSE AS is_strategic_opening, (COALESCE(sm.store_type, '') = 'FR') AS is_franchise, NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, pm.address, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address_detail, '')), '') )), '') AS map_address, sm.latitude AS latitude, sm.longitude AS longitude FROM store_mst sm LEFT OUTER JOIN property_mst pm ON sm.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx ORDER BY sm.store_idx DESC

SELECT prop_idx, prop_nm, zip_cd, address, address_detail, latitude, longitude, region, prop_status, prop_type, floor, cont_area, real_area, rent_deposit, monthly_rent, premium_fee, maint_fee, prop_notes, survey_dt, CAST(create_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS create_dt, CAST(update_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS update_dt, surveyor FROM property_mst ORDER BY prop_idx DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE partner_mst SET partner_status = '가맹점사업자', update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE partner_idx = #{partnerIdx}
UPDATE property_mst SET prop_status = 'CONTRACTED', update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE prop_idx = #{propIdx}
